newsitem.title: USA: U.S. House's Gingrich "confident" of vote.
newsitem.headline: U.S. House's Gingrich "confident" of vote.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich said Monday he is "confident" he will win re-election in Tuesday's House selection of speaker for the new two-year congressional session.

Returning from Georgia to open the new session and face the conclusion of his ethics case, a smiling Gingrich responded to reporters with one word, "confident" when asked how he felt about Tuesday's vote. He declined to comment on fellow Republican Jim Leach's announcement that he would not support Gingrich for a second term as Speaker of the House.
"I think it is a wonderful day to be here and I am sure we will have other things to say later," Gingrich said as he entered his office in the Capitol.
He is to attend a meeting of the Republican conference this evening and, rather than deliver a message to the members, Gingrich said he will be there "to listen."
